introduction.title: See a pattern directly in query output
paragraphs: Textplot creates small charts from ASCII or Unicode characters and returns them as SQL strings. A result can contain a sparkline, a bar, or another compact visual alongside ordinary columns.

Use it while exploring data in the CLI or building a text report. It helps reveal a trend or distribution without opening a separate plotting tool. The output is text, so its appearance depends on the terminal’s font and support for the chosen characters.
